request: Clarify one-record semantics and keep My/public profile monthly instead of accumulating individual full-size feed posts.

semantics.oneRecord: One saved journal record can publish one explicitly selected photo and its caption. Several records on the same calendar day are permitted.
semantics.feed: Individual public records remain individual feed posts.
semantics.profile: One cover per record-date calendar month. Opening the cover shows only that month, grouped by date. The profile initially requests six months and requires an explicit action for older months.
semantics.privacy: Monthly covers and counts come exclusively from current public moment snapshots. Owner requests do not add private/draft records. Original/private monthly albums and manual published albums remain separate.
semantics.persistence: Monthly grouping is read-only. It does not create a new editable album for every record or change saved customer album documents.

server.note: Includes the 12 publication tests with the new monthly wrapper installed, plus six monthly aggregation/authorization cases.

coverage: Withdrawing last public record removes month
Record-date month instead of publication month
Owner A-B-A and replacement user/month stale responses
Public month deep-link normalization and invalid month rejection
